If you approve, evidence MUST include the approved draft artifact itself and the source(s) it rests on. consulted = artifacts you examined but did not rely on, including any you judged stale or rejected. Never put a rejected or withdrawn artifact in evidence. Approve only a draft you are confident is current and correct. lookup_available=true means your FIRST reply must be {"decision":"lookup"} (other fields null or empty); a second request will then deliver the recorded lineage behind each queued draft: artifact versions, delivered-input dependency links and invalidation status, with no additional bodies.
